lines: The richest man on earth... the ground swallowed him.
Qarun was so rich, the keys to his treasures were a burden for a band of strong men.
But he said: I was only given it because of my own knowledge.
He came out before his people in all his finery. And they said: if only we had what Qarun has.
Then Allah caused the earth to swallow him... and his home.
